# Task Template

## Purpose

State the concrete reason this task exists.

## Implementation scope

Describe exactly what should be changed, added, or fixed.

## Inputs / references

List linked feature, epic, docs, files, or design notes.

## Steps

Outline the implementation steps at a practical level.

## Validation

Describe how to verify the task works, including manual and automated checks where relevant.

## Definition of done

State the task-specific completion criteria.

## Notes for implementer

Add constraints, edge cases, or reminders that matter during implementation.
